title: Dimensional reduction and thermodynamics of a non-local scalar field theory
summary: In this paper, we study the dimensional reduction of a nonlocal scalar field theory to 1+2 dimensions. This nonlocal model introduces a light mass parameter as a scale that primarily modifies the infrared regime of the theory. We constraint the external sources to a bidimensional plane to obtain the effective Green's function and propose an effective Lagrangian for the scalar field in 1+2 dimensions.
